summary: Updated the agent resources settings pages to remove duplicate headers (added a `hideHeader` option to `SettingsPage` and enabled it for Skills, Agent resources, and Extensions pages) and softened the 'everything is a card' look in `layout.css` so resource lists and skill lists only get top/bottom separator borders instead of full cards. Then adjusted the skills editor workbench in `skills-library.css` to drop the enclosing border, rounded corners, and surface background while keeping horizontal dividers.
decisions: Added a `hideHeader?: boolean` prop to `SettingsPage.svelte` so callers can suppress the page-level title/scope header when it duplicates the tab label; enabled on Skills, Agent resources, and Extensions pages (Agent retitled from 'Agent' to 'Agent resources').

Replaced full 'card' treatment (border + radius) on resource lists inside agent/extensions settings and on the skills list with only `border-top`/`border-bottom` separators, so lists no longer read as individual cards.

For the skills editor workbench, removed the outer border, border-radius, and surface background from `.skills-library` so the editor no longer looks like one big card, retaining top/bottom separators for visual separation.
